title: Relative tensor functors on internal modules have right adjoints
statement: Let C be a locally v-small Grothendieck abelian category with an additive closed symmetric monoidal structure, and R a commutative monoid object of C. Let Mod(C,R) be the category of left internal R-modules, with its relative tensor product defined as the coequalizer of the two R-actions. For every M in Mod(C,R), the functor M tensor_R (-) has a right adjoint. Consequently Mod(C,R) is monoidal closed.

proof.text: For M,N form the cofork in internal modules whose source is the ordinary tensor M.X tensor N.X with the action on M. Its parallel arrows are the left action on N and the right action on M transported across the associator. The quotient map is linear by whiskerLeft_tensorπ_smul. Reflect the coequalizer along forget R and construct its descent using the defining ambient coequalizer of the monoidal tensor. Associator inverse cancellation identifies the two relations.

Compare this coequalizer with the previously constructed Mod.tensorLeft N using diagramIsoParallelPair and uniqueness of colimits. Naturality follows by colimit.hom_ext and naturality of the tensor quotient map. The older functor preserves colimits, so the actual monoidal tensorRight N does too; the braiding transports this to tensorLeft N.

The already proved Mod.isGrothendieckAbelian provides a separator in Mod(C,R). Apply Mathlib isLeftAdjoint_of_preservesColimits_of_isSeparating to tensorLeft M. Its right adjoint and Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint give the required Closed instance for each M.
